meta.title: Ben Visits Green Hill
meta.textType: story: names of people and places

paragraphs: Tom invited Ben to Grandma and Grandpa's house for the weekend. It was in Green Hill, a small village near the town. The boys went there by bus on Friday afternoon. It was a new place for Ben. Grandma stood at the door and smiled. "Hello, Ben!" she said. "Come in, and take off your shoes." Grandma cooked rice, fish, and a big bowl of soup. "Would you like more rice, Ben?" she asked. "Yes, please," said Ben. "It's very good." After dinner, Ben was tired. He was asleep at eight o'clock.

On Saturday morning, Grandpa took the boys for a walk. They walked along the green rice fields. The sun was hot, and the fields were very green. A big brown cow stood in the field. Ben stopped and looked at it. "Don't be afraid," said Grandpa. "She's a good cow." Then Ben put his foot in the water, and his shoes were wet. "I have boots at home," said Grandpa. "You can change your shoes."

In the afternoon, Ben wore the boots. He walked with Tom to a small shop in the village. They bought two sweets and gave one to Grandpa. On Sunday evening, Ben said, "Thank you, Tom." "I like Green Hill. It's a nice place." Grandma gave him some more rice in a box. "Come again, Ben," said Grandpa. "Now you know the village." Ben smiled and said, "Yes, I want to!"
